title: Project Hierion
definition: A permanent home for CADMIES, serving as a temple of knowledge and a sacred place.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Think of Project Hierion as the official home base for CADMIES, a place where all its knowledge is stored and organized, like a library or digital temple.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: A dedicated platform for the CADMIES knowledge system, designed to provide a permanent home for its vast array of information and serve as a hub for further development.
difficulty_levels.expert: A digital infrastructure designed to host the CADMIES knowledge system, offering a secure and permanent home for its data, resources, and tools, embodying its mission as a temple of knowledge.

extra_fields.insight: The novel insight here is the sacred and reverent nature of Project Hierion, positioning it as a temple dedicated to the preservation and dissemination of knowledge.
